info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Streaming Subscriptions Devices-v4-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Devices API provides a streamlined way to access and retrieve information about the devices linked to active streaming subscriptions. This endpoint is essential for developers looking to manage and monitor devices associated with their subscription services. Typical consumers of this API include application developers and service operators who need to facilitate user experience enhancements or device management features. By utilizing this API, businesses can gain insights into device usage patterns and ensure optimized streaming service delivery.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of devices under subscription.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all devices that are currently under a subscription. It provides detailed information about each device, such as its status and configuration, enabling effective management of IoT devices in use.
